retrievalProfile.description: A moody, low-light composition featuring silhouetted figures against a bokeh-rich urban nightscape with bold, left-aligned geometric typography.
triggerTerms: urban night silhouette with bold text

recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format image depicting two silhouetted figures looking out a window at a blurred city at night. The left side of the frame is dominated by large, white, geometric sans-serif text, while the right side contains the primary human subjects. Warm bokeh circles from city lights contrast with the cool, dark tones of the interior.
coreVisualRelationships: Silhouetted subjects on the right balancing heavy typography on the left
Sharp geometric text against a soft-focus bokeh background
Warm orange/yellow light points against deep blue and black shadows
Vertical window frame acting as a compositional divider

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures occupy the right third of the frame, scaled to appear as if viewed from behind within a room.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white text in the upper-left quadrant serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold text, moves down the left margin, then follows the window frame to the silhouetted couple.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, shadowed interior around the figures provides negative space that emphasizes the bright city lights and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-value, high-contrast scene with saturated warm accents against desaturated darks.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family usage with varying weights or sizes for secondary info.
graphicDevices: Vertical alignment along a common left axis

candidateDirections.reason: Modern geometric feel with excellent legibility.
Open-source alternative with similar geometric properties.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a couple in silhouette looking out a window at a city at night. Use a shallow depth of field to create large, warm amber bokeh circles from the city lights. The interior should be very dark with cool blue tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of left-aligned, all-caps text in a bold geometric sans-serif font in the top-left corner. Use solid white for the text color and ensure wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the background sufficiently blurred to create bokeh?
Are the human figures rendered as dark silhouettes?

adjustableVariables: Cool vs. warm color balance in the shadows
mustRedesign: Avoid using any specific existing brand logos
Ensure the text does not obscure the faces of the silhouettes

mustAchieve: Clear distinction between sharp text and soft background
Legible typography despite the busy bokeh
avoid: Low-contrast text that blends into the lights

postGenerationChecks: Check that text is solid white without transparency
Verify that the silhouette is dark enough to hide facial features
Ensure the bokeh circles are varied in size
Confirm the geometric font has no serifs
recipe.reuseFormula: Nocturnal Silhouette + Bokeh Background + Geometric Sans Overlay
